propositions: The audit page renderer at page.py:329 only accepts kind == 'operator-attested' when computing the lacking flag, but must also accept 'non-codebase' to handle both old and new COMPLETION_VERDICT events.

827 existing tickets in the live store carry COMPLETION_VERDICT events with kind: 'operator-attested' which are immutable and must continue to render correctly after S5 changes the verifier to emit 'non-codebase'.
Criterion kind comparison in page.py:329 is the only site in the codebase that validates this field against a hardcoded string value.
A criterion with kind: 'operator-attested' or kind: 'non-codebase' and met: false must render with lacking: true.
A criterion with kind: 'codebase-verifiable' must render unaffected regardless of the kind value change.
